title: Get Aggregator Working End to End
description: Get aggregator working end to end. Currently no windows show content. Error: Fehlendes Fenster: puzzle3d-main-perspective
summary: Fixed UIIntroduction crash on Aggregator boot: `step.demonstrations` was undefined for hand-written brand steps (Rust `#[serde(default)]` does not apply to plain TS objects), so `.length` threw and blanked the shell. UIIntroduction now treats missing demonstrations as empty and still auto-demos Next on informational steps. Brand steps already carry explicit `demonstrations: []` where none are authored. Vitest covers omitted demonstrations; Playwright on :6023 confirms welcome intro, Next through step 5 with zero pageerrors, and after Skip Top+Perspective canvases with Abbau Aufbau content.
